summary: Iteration 9 (LUXE Inventory) — all P0/P1 backend features verified via 8 new TestIteration9 pytest cases. Full suite: 35/35 pass (7 iter8 + 8 iter9 + 20 legacy). Backend endpoints POST /api/categories/merge (400 same-id, 404 unknown, moves costumes+clears subcat, deletes discard), GET /api/categories/similar (empty→[], fuzzy match works, returns similarity score, excludes self), POST /api/admin/migrate-legacy-flags (creates Legacy flag cat, converts is_flagged+empty-flags→flags array), GET /api/in-use (only in_use=True, sorted by in_use_since desc), /api/stats now includes in_use_count, Costume model accepts note_image_ids/in_use/in_use_note with in_use_since auto-set-on-true / cleared-on-false (round-trip verified), Flag image_ids supported on create+POST+PUT, Show link_timestamp persists via POST+PUT+GET. Frontend testids verified live via Playwright: global-search-open toggles global-search-input; global-search-close closes; mobile-nav-toggle reveals mobile-nav with 7 links (390px viewport); Costume form renders form-note-image-btn, form-note-image-input, form-in-use-switch (turning on reveals form-in-use-note), form-flag-add-select+form-flag-image-input-0 after adding a flag; loc-new-btn toggles form-new-location container with -name/-parent/-save children; Settings shows merge-cat-card + merge-keeper-select + merge-discard-select + merge-cat-btn + migrate-legacy-btn; Shows Add-Show dialog exposes show-form-timestamp input; Dashboard in-use-tile present in stats grid.

issues: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, Accessories'. Root cause verified via GET /api/categories which returns 10 rows with two entries named 'Accessories' (two distinct ids). This is legacy data, and iteration-9 merge-cat-card is the intended remediation. Non-blocking but suggest (a) use category.id as the React key everywhere instead of name, (b) show the merge card prominently when duplicate names are detected.

action_items: Frontend: replace name-as-key with id-as-key in category .map() calls (silences React duplicate-key warning triggered by the two 'Accessories' rows in seed data).
Optional: on Settings load, if duplicate category names are detected, auto-scroll/highlight the merge-cat-card to guide the user.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1533 lines — split into routers (costumes, flags, categories, shows, admin, uploads) is overdue.
Repeated pattern of adding new fields to both response and payload Pydantic models — link_timestamp / in_use / note_image_ids / image_ids all done correctly this iter (learning from iter-7/8 misses).
/api/categories/similar uses difflib.SequenceMatcher which is O(n) per category on every keystroke; fine at current scale but consider debounce on FE.
/api/admin/migrate-legacy-flags is idempotent-ish (only touches is_flagged=True with empty flags) but multiple runs create duplicate 'Legacy' category lookups; find_one guard exists — OK.
in_use_since is stored as ISO string; consider using datetime for MongoDB-native sort (works currently because ISO 8601 sorts lexicographically).
